record.reason: ViCuR adds a sink-token cue-recovery module during prefill and improves multimodal reasoning on seven benchmarks while preserving the inference interface; it is a distillation/training method, not a measured latency or memory optimization. Cue quality is a stated limitation.
record.title: ViCuR: Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
